Shanghai Municipal Police.
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
October 26 1921
REPORT ON Provincial Autonomy Co-operative Society
Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.
Sir,
The prime mover in the foundation of the above
Provincial Autonomy Co-operative Society which it is
proposed to form at 420a North Chengtu Road is Hsiung Hsi
Ling(熊希齡), who is at present in Peking and who has held
several important posts in the Peking Government. The
two persons who are taking an active part in the formation
of the society locally are Zee Veh Soo(徐佛蘇), a native
of Hunan who came to Shanghai at the beginning of 1919 as
a member of the suite of Chu Chi Chien(朱啟鈐), the
Northern Peace Delegate, and who claims to hold the honorary
rank of adviser to the Chinese Government, and Tong Fah Yeu
(湯叢予), native of Kiangse, an ex-M.P. who claims to be
an adviser to the Board of Finance. Zee resides at 420a
North Chengtu Road and Tong at 183 South Chengtu Road. The
expenses incurred in promoting the society have so far been
paid by Hsiung Hsi Ling(熊希齡) who contributed $1,000.00
and Zee and Tong. About 60 persons most of whom are in
Peking, have been enrolled as members of the society.
The promoters claim that their sole object is to
help to bring about peace between the Northern and Southern
parties and to encourage the establishment of Provincial
Self-government. They state that their reason for forming
the society in Shanghai is that if it was formed in Peking
it would excite suspicion and distrust on the part of the
Southern Party, but if the society is a success the head-
quarters will be removed to Peking. The regulations, of

1921年10月26日
关于省自治协进会的报告
由 D. I. Sullivan 撰写，经刑事情报处处长转呈。

先生，
拟于成都北路420a号成立的上述“省自治协进会”的主要发起人是熊希齡（Hsiung Hsi Ling），他目前在北京，曾在北洋政府担任多个重要职务。在当地积极参与该会组建工作的两人是徐佛蘇（Zee Veh Soo），湖南人，1919年初作为北方和平代表朱啟鈐（Chu Chi Chien）的随员来到上海，自称拥有中国政府顾问的荣誉头衔；以及湯叢予（Tong Fah Yeu），江西人，前国会议员，自称是财政部顾问。徐佛蘇居住于成都北路420a号，湯叢予居住于成都南路183号。迄今为止，推动该会所产生的费用均由熊希齡（捐赠了1,000.00美元）以及徐、汤二人支付。约有60人被登记为该会会员，其中大多数人在北京。
发起人声称，他们的唯一目标是帮助实现南北双方的和平，并鼓励建立省自治制度。他们表示，选择在上海成立该会的原因是，如果在北京成立，会引起南方派的怀疑和不信任；但如果该会运作成功，总部将迁往北京。随附章程副本仅为暂定草案，尚未决定拟创办的报纸将在上海还是其他地方出版。该会举行的任何会议将仅限会员参加，不向公众开放。

23rd October 1921.

REPORT ON A letter received on the 23rd October by Inspector in
charge, Sinza Station.

Made by D.S.I. Kiloh.    Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
    I beg to report that attached letter(and translation)
was received at Sinza Station on the 23rd October addressed
to the Inspector in charge. This letter intimates that
a Sub-association for the purpose of investigating into the
question of provincial self-government, has been opened at
Chinese dwelling house No.420a N. Chengtu Road, (Tsunf Chi
Lee Alleyway 庆吉里 ), the letter states that they intend to
hold meetings at this address once or twice weekly, this
letter is signed by Bang Ying Zung (彭應丞 ), Secretary of the
"Sub-association for the purpose of investigating into the
question of provincial self-government". No 420a N.Chengtu
Road is occupied by Sz Tsai Tsung (施再春 ), a native of
Chekiang, he is the master of gold shop, Poh Tai Hung (葆泰亨 )
in the Ming Yu Lee Alleyway (民裕里 ), Honan Road, and Zoo
Veh Soo (徐苏佛 ), a native of Hunan (湖南.) and political
adviser to the President of China. Fifteen men had a
consultation at this address between 4 and 4-30 p.m. on the
23rd October re publishing a periodical in favour of
provincial self-government, The Eastern Times (时事新报), had
two representatives, The Chun Hwa Sin Pao (中华新报), one,
The Kok Wang Toong Sin Zoo (国文通讯社), one, Zing Wei Uhing
(刘伟成), stock broker, Lieu Kwaung Li (刘光烈.), a former
Southern Peace Delegate and, Lieu Nyoh Sz (刘玉书.), an adviser
to the President of China, Thaung Fei Yu (汤斐予 ), member of
the Southern Parliament and Chairman of the Constitutional
Drafting Committee, the others who attended this consultation

Draft of Regulations for the Provincial
Autonomy Co-operative Society.
--------

1.- The objects of our proposal to establish a
Provincial Autonomy Co-operative Society are :-
(a) To secure a definite policy to reform
the country by the co-operation of all
provinces.
(b) To furnish autonomy for the people.
(c) To co-operate in the improvement of affairs
relating to autonomy in the various provinces
and districts.
(d) To hasten the holding of a Provincial
Conference for the unity of the country.

2.- The affairs of this society are :-
(a) To discuss the Provincial and National
Constitutions.
(b) To discuss proposals for other policies.
(c) To publish printed matter periodically
or otherwise.
(d) To prepare for simple lectures and to
devise ways and means to furnish discussion
towards world questions.
(d) To publish declarations, etc. regarding
the aim and work of this society.

3.- The Society will be first organized by
promoters and supporters. Those who agree
with the objects of the Society may become
members on being introduced by at least
three members of the Society.

4.- The members of the Society will nominate a
Directorate which will decide on all questions
concerning the Society. There will be a
Chairman for the Directorate to manage the
Society's affairs. The Directorate should
only take up office after the Society has been
formally inaugurated for 3 months. Five
persons amongst the members will be appointed
as preparatory officers before the Direc-
torate is nominated.

5.- The ██████████ Society will elect a Special
Committee to carry out the work mentioned in
a,b,c,d, of Art. 2. This committee, the
number of whose members is not fixed, is
to be appointed by the Directorate. Rules
governing the committee are stated below
separately.

注：在会员招募活动开始之前，不得发布任何宣言。

省自治协进会章程草案。
--------

1.- 我们提议成立省自治协进会的目标如下：
(a) 通过各省合作，确立改革国家的确切政策。
(b) 为人民提供自治。
(c) 合作改善各省及各地区与自治有关的事务。
(d) 加速召开省级会议，以实现国家统一。

2.- 本会事务如下：
(a) 讨论省宪及国宪。
(b) 讨论其他政策提案。
(c) 定期或以其他方式出版印刷品。
(d) 筹备简易讲座，并 devised 方式方法以提供关于世界问题的讨论。
(d) 发布关于本会宗旨及工作的宣言等。（注：原文有两个(d)项）

3.- 本会将首先由发起人和支持者组织。凡赞同本会宗旨者，经至少三名本会会员介绍，可成为会员。

4.- 本会会员将提名一个理事会，由其决定有关本会的所有问题。理事会设主席一人，负责管理本会事务。理事会应在本会正式成立三个月后方可就职。在提名理事会之前，将从会员中任命五人为筹备干事。

5.- ██████████ 本会将选举一个特别委员会，以执行第2条a、b、c、d款所述工作。该委员会人数不定，由理事会任命。管辖该委员会的规则另行规定如下。

6.- The work of the officers of the Society
is voluntary, but those who work daily
for the Society or who bear expenses on
the Society's business will be paid from
the Society's fund.

7.- In order to carry into effect the work
mentioned in (d) of Art. 1, the Society
will establish a committee composed of
members elected from representatives of all
provinces. The election will be directed
by the Directorate.

8.- The entrance fee for members is $4.00
and when emergency requires, members are
obliged to subscribe for special purposes.

9.- The central headquarters of the Society
will be in Shanghai.

10.- The above regulations will be enforced
immediately they are passed by the
inauguration meeting and to be discussed,
revised, or re-drafted again by the
Provincial Conference.

Draft of rules governing the Directorate.
----------

1.- The Directorate will hold a meeting once
every three months.

2.- Special meetings are to be held at the
request of three or more members or of the
Chairman of the Directorate.

3.- Ordinary meetings of the Directorate will
only be held when a majority of the directors
are present; special meetings, one-third
of the members necessary.

4.- Resolutions at meetings of the Directorate
will be considered passed when supported by
over half of those present.

5.- Chairman and members of the Directorate
when unable to attend meetings owing to
reasonable causes may ask other members
to act as their representatives.

6.- The sending of all documents bearing the
name of the Society is at the disposal of
the Directorate or the Chairman of the
Directorate.

7.- All affairs of the Society relating to
secretarial, treasury, etc. will be
managed by the Directorate. The Chairman
to stamp all documents containing decisions
passed at meetings.

6.- 本会职员的工作为义务性质，但每日为本会工作或承担本会业务费用者，将从本会基金中支付报酬。

7.- 为了执行第1条(d)款所述工作，本会将设立一个委员会，由从各省代表中选出的会员组成。选举工作由理事会指导。

8.- 会员入会费为4.00美元，遇紧急情况时，会员有义务为特定目的捐款。

9.- 本会总部设在上海。

10.- 上述章程一经成立大会通过即刻生效，并将由省级会议进行讨论、修订或重新起草。

理事会管理规则草案。
----------

1.- 理事会每三个月举行一次会议。

2.- 经三名或以上会员或理事会主席请求，可举行特别会议。

3.- 理事会常规会议仅在多数理事出席时方可举行；特别会议需三分之一成员出席即可。

4.- 理事会会议决议，经出席者过半数支持，即视为通过。

5.- 理事会主席及成员如因合理原因无法出席会议，可委托其他成员作为其代表。

6.- 所有以本会名义发出的文件，由理事会或理事会主席处置。

7.- 本会所有涉及秘书、财务等事务，由理事会管理。主席需在包含会议通过决定的所有文件上盖章。

1. 11. 21

8.- The above rules will be enforced on
the approval of the Directorate.

Draft of rules governing the
Special Committee

1.- The Special Committee is to appoint two
Chinese and two Foreign secretaries anda
certain number of editors and inspectors.

2.- The Special Committee is to discuss and to
decide on the following matters :—

(a) To decide on the proposed discussion
of problems and to suggest resolutions.
(b) To investigate or to discuss the
suggested resolutions.
(c) To edit occasional publications.
(d) To translate into foreign languages
declarations or suggestions which the
Society thinks necessary.
(e) To report on investigations, etc.

3.- Meetings of the Special Committee to be
called by the secretary. The Chairman at
such meetings to be elected temporarily.

4.- Members of the Society may suggest reso-
lutions to the Committee.

5.- Resolutions suggested by the committee
itself must be carefully discussed after
investigations are made.

6.- The passing of resolutions by members
of the Society should be as follows :—

(a) To send out circulars enclosing a
copy of the resolution and stating the
date which it is to be discussed to
all members of the Society.
(b) Members unable to attend the meeting
must send to the committee their opinions
regarding the resolution.
(c) Such opinions as stated in (b) shall
be conveyed to the members present at the
meeting or shall be read at the meeting.
(d) After discussion the committee shall
communicate to all members a report of
the discussion regarding the resolutions
which have been discussed. The members,
then, shall vote and the resolutions to
be declared passed or defeated.

7.- Individuals or organizations concerned in
the resolution are allowed to give their
opinion and to discuss same. In this case
the committee should not consider the right
of membership.

1. 11. 21

8.- 上述规则经理事会批准后生效。

特别委员会管理规则草案

1.- 特别委员会将任命两名中文秘书和两名外文秘书，以及若干编辑和视察员。

2.- 特别委员会将讨论并决定以下事项：—

(a) 确定拟讨论的问题并提出决议建议。
(b) 调查或讨论建议的决议。
(c) 编辑不定期出版物。
(d) 将本会认为必要的宣言或建议翻译成外文。
(e) 报告调查结果等。

3.- 特别委员会会议由秘书召集。此类会议的主席临时选举产生。

4.- 本会会员可向委员会提出决议建议。

5.- 委员会自身提出的决议，必须在进行调查后仔细讨论。

6.- 本会会员通过决议的程序如下：—

(a) 向本会全体会员发出通函，附上决议副本，并注明讨论日期。
(b) 无法出席会议的会员必须向委员会提交其对决议的意见。
(c) (b)款所述意见应传达给出席会议的会员，或在会议上宣读。
(d) 讨论结束后，委员会应向全体会员通报关于已讨论决议的讨论报告。随后，会员进行投票，宣布决议通过或否决。

7.- 与决议有关的个人或组织允许发表意见并进行讨论。在此情况下，委员会不应考虑其会员资格权利。

8.- Matters relating to editing periodical
publications are at the disposal of the
editorial committee. Expenses incurred
in this work to be subscribed separately.

9.- Investigations, etc. in foreign countries
are to be the work of those who will be
sent out for same.

10.-The above rules will be enforced after
having been passed by the committee

Draft of a letter to the various provinces
and special districts for mebership campaign.
----------

The idea of Provincial Autonomy as the most
suitable governing system for our country was long
ago advocated by able politicians who believe that
by this system only can the unity of the country be
secured. Our country first took up the task of
promoting a new government during the period when the
Tsing Dynasty was most civilised up to the establish-
ment of the Republic. The fight between the new
and the old factions, the two greatest antagonists,
in putting forth their own but entirely different
ideas for a government does not at all give an
opportunity to organize the country from the foundation.
Three ideas of a government are being suggested, viz:-
(1) Militaristic Republic, (2) a central government
with absolute power and (3) Parliamentary Government.
The harm arising out of these governments are,
absolute militarism, the division of North and South,
and the quarrel between the two opposite parliaments.
The situation now is such that nothing can maintain
it. The people have begun to understand the situation.
They now know thoroughly well that the cause is
the bad system of government. Following this, the
idea of a Provincial Autonomy becomes more agreeable
daily and is gradually being declared and supported
by the people to be the best project for the country.
We are endeavouring to bring this system into effect,
however, as this concerns the affairs of the entire
country and moreover the work can not be performed by
one or two provinces or special districts or by a few
persons, we are now opening a membership campaign
pages.zh:
4188
L. 11. 21.

致各省及特别区以开展会员招募运动的信函草稿。
----------

省自治作为我国最适宜的治理体制，早已由干练的政治家所倡导，他们认为唯有通过此体制方能确保国家统一。我国自清朝最为开明时期起，直至民国建立，便着手推行新政府之任务。新旧两派——这两大对立阵营——在提出各自截然不同之治国理念时的争斗，根本未提供从基础层面组织国家的机会。目前有人提出三种政府构想，即：(1) 军国共和制，(2) 拥有绝对权力的中央政府，以及 (3) 议会政府制。这些政府体制所带来的危害分别是：绝对的军国主义、南北分裂，以及两个对立议会之间的争执。当前局势已至任何事物均无法维持之境。民众已开始认清局势。他们现在充分明白，根源在于不良的政府体制。随之，省自治的理念日益获得认同，并逐渐被民众宣告和支持为国家的最佳方案。我们正努力使此体制得以实施，然而，由于此事关乎全国事务，且非一两个省或特别区或少数人所能完成，我们现在正于全国范围内开展会员招募运动，

throughout the country with a view to organizing
a co-operative society in Shanghai. Opinions from
the people will be gathered and efforts will be
made to bring forth practical improvements. These
are our objects. The duty of an individual
should never be neglected. We know you very well,

mination. Therefore we state herein our reasons

The above letter is supposed to be signed

pages.zh:
旨在上海组织一个合作社团。我们将收集民众意见，并致力促成切实的改进。此乃我们的目标。个人之责任绝不可忽视。先生，我们对您的才干、学识及坚定决心深为了解。因此，我们在此陈述组织本社团的理由，并随函附上章程草案等供阁下参阅，恳请阁下如赞同我方提议，即在贵辖区及周边地区征集支持者，以实现我们的目标。

上述信函拟由北京和上海的发起人与支持者署名。
